overall_explanation:
No P0/P1 defects found in the bundle.

Verified against the review focus:
- No-inference no-op: exit 0 goes through record_precheck (dispatch=false, no error) and finish_run(SkippedUnchanged) before resolve_thread/send_turn, so no thread or turn is created; the integration test asserts no thread/start or turn/start RPCs and null thread_id/input_tokens.
- Failure dispatch is rate-limited and durable: the six-hour reservation is set inside a single ControlService::mutate on the automation definition (not the run), returned atomically, and tests cover concurrent double-call, restart and run-history pruning. Agent startup failure after reservation consumes it, which is documented.
- Permissions/trust boundary: precheck creation/update reuses the existing automation.create/update capability (expected_revision, origin/scope checks, target validation). validate() rejects non-Codex providers, missing/unknown sandbox_mode, isolated targets, and any approval policy other than never/on-request/on-failure (unknown values fail closed). Execution re-validates, checks inherited approval policy and isolated/cloud execution targets for reused threads, canonicalizes cwd under the canonicalized workspace (symlink escape test present), passes argv with no shell and no env overrides, and sends an explicit sandboxPolicy, timeoutMs, outputBytesCap and processId to command/exec with command/exec/terminate on daemon-side timeout. This matches the documented Codex app-server contract ([Codex App Server docs](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server), [PR #13640](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/13640)); the known upstream hang after outputBytesCap ([issue #13821](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/13821)) is bounded by the daemon deadline and recorded as a timeout failure, so it fails closed.
- Bounded storage: per-stream 8 KiB cap at capture, UTF-8-safe bounding, and a 512 KiB aggregate evidence budget in compact() with no usize underflow (keep.len() <= budget). Test keeps the store under MAX_STORE_BYTES.
- History/health: run.precheck and automation.last_precheck are persisted; health exposes precheck, last_precheck and precheck_failures, and agent_ms now excludes runs with no thread.

Lower-priority observations omitted per threshold (e.g., validate() performing blocking canonicalize inside the mutate closure so any update fails if the cwd is temporarily absent; the inherited-thread check silently skips when thread_summary errors; Codex may report timeouts with a code other than 124, which still lands in the failure path).
